Question: Has your name ever appeared in any newspaper? When and why did this happen for the first time? How did you feel and what was your reaction?
Answer: Well, the first and the second time were ads run by my school after board exams and had my phot with several other good scorers. I don’t wish to add ads in here. So, the typical first time had my photo and my name in regional newspapers when I was serving in Akola, Maharashtra and imparted training during the 7th Economic Census. I have two of the clippings from 2019: I fondly remember the day I spent with my colleagues and thoroughly enjoyed the process. I see this and I’m proud that the next time I appear in a local newspaper, I will not only be “sahayak” (assistant) but “sahaayak nideshak” (Assistant Director). As a matter of fact, I did in local Kerala newspaper but I don’t have the clippings. How far life has come but I still see these as my golden days. It has taught me the most in life.

Question: I'm an MSc first year student, 2nd semester and I'm thinking of dropping for 6 months to prepare for a government job exam. Is it right to drop my MSc?
Answer: No, don’t drop out unless you get a job. Better and higher degrees increase your chance to make a better switch even within the government sector.

Question: Who thinks we should bring back anonymous questions and answers?
Answer: I hope Quora does that soon. I had enjoyed writing some answers anonymously in the past. There is a lot I wish to share but some things are too personal and after meeting a lot of my readers face to face, it makes me feel a bit awkward at times- as if they know so much about me already. Question: Is Gazette of India for just my father's correct surname applicable in document verification of the SSC CGL or any other government exams?
Answer: Just mention your father’s name as it is mentioned in your class 10th certificate. Your father’s documents will not be verified.
